title: Advancement Progress
description: A mod that shows you the progress of your advancements!
body:
# Advancement Progress A simple mod that shows you how many advancements you've completed. ![Husbandry Advancements 8/29](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/185ced937191739b2cb0782ef1f63d2ce6656f7e.png) Have fun! _In case you have a question, problem or feature suggestion:
Feel free to contact me via [Discord](https://discord.gg/vDuYhAAamG) or open an issue on my [github](https://github.com/liushmn/AdvancementProgress/issues)_
